# UAE Quick - Same-Day Home Maintenance Services in Dubai

> UAE Quick (UAE Quick Technical Services LLC) is a Dubai home maintenance company providing same-day AC repair, handyman and plumbing, electrical, cleaning, movers and packers, painting and partitions, interior design, garden maintenance and pool maintenance across 14 Dubai communities. Fixed prices quoted in writing before work begins, no call-out fee, 30-day workmanship guarantee. Book before 4 PM for a same-day visit.

## Services (starting prices, AED)
- AC Repair - from AED 150: Same-day AC repair, cleaning, gas refill and installation across Dubai. Fixed pricing from AED 150. https://uaequick.com/services/ac-repair
- Handyman & Plumber - from AED 80: Furniture fixing, leak repair, door locks, tap & sink, gypsum work. Same-day, from AED 80. https://uaequick.com/services/handyman-plumber
- Electrician - from AED 100: DEWA-aware electricians for wiring, lights, sockets, breakers and rewiring. From AED 100. https://uaequick.com/services/electrician
- Cleaning - from AED 35/hr: Deep cleaning, villa cleaning, move-in/out and upholstery. Supplies included, from AED 35/hr. https://uaequick.com/services/cleaning
- Movers & Packers - from AED 450: Apartment, villa and office moves with packing, dismantling and reassembly. From AED 450. https://uaequick.com/services/movers-packers
- Painting & Partitions - from AED 350: Villa, apartment and office painting, plus gypsum partitions and false ceilings. From AED 350. https://uaequick.com/services/painting
- Interior Design - from Free consultation: Home, office and restaurant interior design with fit-out, joinery and approvals handled. https://uaequick.com/services/interior-design
- Garden Maintenance - from AED 200: Landscaping, lawn care, irrigation and palm trimming for Dubai villas. From AED 200. https://uaequick.com/services/garden-maintenance
- Pool Maintenance - from AED 250: Pool cleaning, chemical balancing, pump repair and jacuzzi service for Dubai villas. From AED 250. https://uaequick.com/services/pool-maintenance
